# TinyStudio.io

TinyStudio.io runs a human-reviewed leak audit for high-ticket service businesses, free, and a desk that closes the leaks the audit finds.

Canonical URL: https://tinystudio.io/
Contact: hello@tinystudio.io

## The Free Leak Audit

The audit is complimentary and the findings are yours to keep. It reads the one page a business's revenue depends on — usually the homepage — the way a customer with intent reads it, across four passes:

- The money page: the precise points at which a ready-to-buy visitor loses interest
- The paid creative: whether top spend is genuinely distinct concepts, not one idea wearing ten hooks
- The unanswered: which pre-purchase questions the page settles, if any
- The reach: whether new work is reaching new people or quietly re-serving an existing audience

The deliverable is a short, plain document: named leaks, in the order they cost the business money, with the fix beside each one. No deck, no dashboard. Findings are delivered within five working days. Capacity is six audits a month; when the sixth is taken, intake closes until the next month.

The reading is done by seven specialist agents, each with a single job, a fixed set of inputs and a checklist it must satisfy. Nothing reaches a client until a person has read it line by line; every client-facing output carries one human signature. Client work is never published: no logos, no case studies, no testimonials.

## The Growth Desk

The paid desk runs at $2,500 per month on a three-month minimum. Month one closes the leak: the highest-leverage page is rewritten or rebuilt, with a dev-ready handoff if the client's own team ships it. Months two and three run the loop: weekly checks, one revision, and tracking that says whether the fix held.

Delivery guarantee: if the month-one deliverables are not in the client's hands within fourteen working days of Day 0, month one is refunded in full. Day 0 begins only once payment, access, and both named owners are recorded; the clock pauses while the desk is waiting on the client. This is a promise about the desk's work, not the client's market.

## The Agent Desk

The Agent Desk is the engine behind the free brief and remains reachable at /agent-desk. Cloudflare Workers AI generates the Pipeline Brief, Implementation Checklist, and Weekly Fix Report server-side from an email and a business snapshot, with optional detail inputs (offer, target buyer, proof, market, funnel, follow-up/CRM context, weekly lead-to-call metrics, bottleneck, constraints). Client-side code does not call model providers, platform admin APIs, ad accounts, databases, or private credentials directly.

The agents infer missing context, label assumptions, and ask only true blocker questions when missing information would prevent a useful next step.

## Safety And Limits

TinyStudio does not promise revenue, ROAS, profit, booked calls, rankings, AI visibility, conversion lift, or sales lift.

The desk does not publish campaigns, change ad spend, connect to ad accounts, send prospect messages, publish anything to a client's site, sync CRM outcomes to ad platforms, or replace a sales team. Claims, ad spend, campaign publishing, platform connections, tracking implementation, and compliance-sensitive decisions remain approval-gated, and automation never approves its own work.

## Data Handling

The public app stores email signup and lightweight usage metadata in Cloudflare D1, including daily rate-limit counters and a daily IP-derived rate-limit key. The business snapshot, optional details, weekly metrics, and generated artifacts are processed to generate the output and are not stored by this app.

There is no public endpoint for reading collected emails or usage metadata.
